title: Whole Truncated Hub and Six Open Square Sockets
description: One wholly newly authored complete hollow six-socket structural-connector-inspired prop. Eight broad hexagonal outside facets form a truncated-octahedral central hub, with their own full inner cavity faces. Six whole diamond-oriented square-section socket necks extend along the three opposed orthogonal axis pairs. Every socket has a genuine open square bore, complete thick side walls and a full annular square end rim; all six mouths enter the same empty central chamber. The whole material boundary is one connected closed editable mesh, with no interpenetrating hidden tubes or internal caps. The lower complete socket rim is the upright art-display sole. Unlike the old coaxial jaw-and-spider coupling this is one hollow multi-axis node, not two opposing annular jaw hubs and an interleaved insert. Unlike a floor-bearing three-way corridor there is no walking floor, ceiling bay or architectural route. All numeric faces are newly authored, no old coupling, beam, corridor or lattice node imported or extracted. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, full horizontal bounds centred over the lowest socket rim, one complete connector model zero scenes. Abstract structural-node-inspired art only: no actual member attachments, threads, fasteners, joint engagement, hollow-section compatibility, torque or load transmission, pressure or fluid rating, fabrication, manufacture, installation or structural safety capability made or verified. No rigging, animation or interaction.
